title: On Moy-Prasad quotients over Laurent series fields
summary: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and $G$ a connected reductive group over $k((t))$ satisfying some conditions. We define a stratification by conjugacy classes of twisted Levi subgroups of $G$ on each Moy-Prasad quotient $\mathfrak{k}_{x,r}/\mathfrak{k}_{x,r+}$ of $G$. We then calculate the strata in terms of the associated twisted Levi subgroups. This calculation is necessary for several followup papers on the local geometric Langlands program.
